verdict.rationale: cubic documents a `cubic.yaml` file at the repository root as the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns (path filters), PR descriptions, and custom agents. It also supports an org-wide `cubic-config` repository. A community comment independently confirms that rules are kept in the codebase. Missing for 10: explicit per-path scoped instructions (custom agents are documented, but not as path-scoped), named review profiles or presets in the config, and a schema-level reference showing these fields.
